subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Archaeologists found part of an ancient road under a modern street.”?
options: The old man smiled and said, "A song does not stay in the air, but people still sing."
On hot summer days, people in Maple City usually walk on the east side of Green Road.
The city created a glass-covered section in the sidewalk so people could see part of the old road while still walking safely above it.
When the station opened, commuters could see the wall behind glass while walking to trains.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The old man smiled and said, 'A song does not stay in the air, but people still sing.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「On hot summer days, people in Maple City usually walk on the east side of Green Road.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The city created a glass-covered section in the sidewalk so people could see part of the old road while still walking safely…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「When the station opened, commuters could see the wall behind glass while walking to trains.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The city created a glass-covered section in the sidewalk so people could see part of the old road while still walking safely above it.」，答案為「The city created a glass-covered section in the sidewalk so people could see part of the old road…」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The city created a glass-covered section in the sidewalk so people could see part of the old road…」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
